text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
choice_data_list: Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Ah, no, please carry on as you 
were.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than resting now, pushing myself 
hard here feels like it'd teach me far 
more, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's that saying about getting stronger 
once you know your limits, right? I wanted 
to put that to the test.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That may be true, but still... As I 
pondered, Wonder Acute looked straight 
back at me."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We'll be having more and more races from 
now on, right? I don't wanna make a fool 
of myself when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to face the other Umamusume and the 
Trainers with everything I've got. ...With 
these legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute always carries a calm, gentle 
presence around her. Yet right now, a 
serious determination burned in her eyes—
choice_data_list: ...All right, let's push past your limits!

Let's not push ourselves to the point of 
collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, thank you. It's reassuring to 
know you'll be working hard right 
alongside me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No need to go easy on me, put me through 
the wringer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Wonder Acute, I continued 
training that pushed us to our absolute 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need to fret, alright? I'll be 
sure to see this through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once training is over, let's have some tea 
and relax. I'm sure it'll taste especially 
wonderful~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Wonder Acute, I continued 
training that pushed us just the right 
amount.
